decision: The competitor (Scuderia AlphaTauri) is fined €1,000 and the driver is given a warning.
fact: Pit lane speeding – 76.2 km/h Infringment Breach of Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulation and noncompliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 13, document 13).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda) and team representative and examined video and timing evidence. Car 22 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 60 km/h for this event by 16.2 km/h. The car was entering the pits having struck the barrier at Turn 11, and the Stewards were concerned that speeding in a pit lane by over 16 kph when there was unknown damage to the car was potentially dangerous. The driver acknowledged that he failed to engage the pit speed limiter and understood the potential of the situation. The Stewards issued a Warning in addition to the mandated fine.

stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Infringement Car 22 Pit Lane Speeding
